source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; references August 2025 pricing change
snippet_primary: "Patreon now charges a flat 10% platform fee (people joining after August 4, 2025) plus 2.9% + $0.30 payment processing on every transaction. That's 13% total. The math: At $5,000/month revenue, you're paying $650 monthly in fees, $7,800 annually. Scale to $10,000/month and you're losing $15,600 per year."
subject_exact: Fees de Patreon según BuddyBoss: 10% flat de platform fee (para quienes se unen después del 4 de agosto de 2025) más 2.9% + $0.30 de procesamiento por transacción, declarado como 13% total, con ejemplos calculados a $5,000 y $10,000 mensuales
metric_value_raw: flat 10% platform fee (people joining after August 4, 2025) plus 2.9% + $0.30 payment processing; That's 13% total
parser_notes: Métricas adicionales (cálculos derivados del autor): a $5,000/mes → $650 mensuales en fees, $7,800 anuales; a $10,000/mes → $15,600 por año.
